title: T1C Transport Enum and Definition-Time Invariants
description: Definition-time specification comparing three same-arithmetic transports: host_push, local_publisher, and bar_pull for LateBind sidecar publication and CPU reduce.

common_arithmetic_invariants.arithmetic_identity: Identical dot product, scaling, and reduction results across all three transports; transport choice alters physical buffer location and transfer mechanism only, never arithmetic semantics

sequence: GPU writes Q8Packed sidecar payload to host-imported memory buffer
GPU issues memory/release barrier ensuring payload visibility
GPU writes ready flag (generation sequence) to host-visible slot
CPU polls/spins on ready flag in host RAM/L3
Upon ready == generation, CPU executes reduction in host RAM/L3

host_push.tradeoff_notes: Lowest CPU read latency if L3 cache snoop / host bridge sustains GPU push without cache thrashing; depends on host-imported coherent memory support.

sequence: GPU producer writes payload to standard device-local VRAM
Dedicated micro-publisher dispatch copies local payload to host-visible staging buffer
Publisher dispatches ready flag release upon copy completion
CPU observes ready flag after publisher completion
CPU reduces payload from staging buffer

local_publisher.tradeoff_notes: Isolates producer kernel from PCIe write stalls at the cost of an extra micro-publisher GPU dispatch and CB overhead.

sequence: GPU producer writes payload directly to BAR-mapped device-coherent VRAM
GPU writes ready flag to BAR-mapped flag slot with device release barrier
CPU checks ready flag over PCIe BAR
CPU performs uncached/WC direct read of payload over PCIe bus and reduces via AVX2

bar_pull.tradeoff_notes: Zero extra GPU dispatches, but high CPU read latency due to PCIe read round-trips; current default scheme subject to hardware adjudication.

invariant_rules: PAYLOAD_BEFORE_READY: Payload bytes must be committed and visible before ready flag transition is observed.
GENERATION_TAGGING: Ready flags must carry monotonic generation tags to prevent ABA hazards on ring slot reuse.
RETAIN_ON_UNKNOWN_COMPLETION: In the event of fence or drain timeout, resources must be retained, not prematurely freed.
IDENTICAL_ARITHMETIC: Output tensor of reduce step must evaluate to identical bit/epsilon representation regardless of transport used.
